Horizontally reflect ONLY THE TEAL FOOTBALLER in these two cells so his HEAD IS ON THE RIGHT, nearest the goalkeeper and goal, and his BOOTS ARE ON THE LEFT. Keep the same teal-shirt cream-shorts adult male footballer, orange-shirt adult male HUMAN goalkeeper, crisp outlined pixel-art aesthetic and right-hand goal. Original generic humans, no brands or lettering.

9 rolls from back onto side safely on ground, no cartwheel.
10 gets up and turns toward camera, goal right, keeper disappointed.
11 small victory leap.
12 balanced arms-wide victory stance.
Stable fixed camera, identical goal position, same scale and grass baseline in all 12 cells. Nothing cropped or crossing cell boundaries; comfortable empty margins. Entire sheet 4x3 equal tiles, exactly 12 distinct authored poses. True transparent PNG background, NOT a painted checkerboard, no grid lines, labels or numbers.
